items.prompt: Which invariant encloses the nonnegative square root in this component?

options.why: That compares a root bracket directly with its squared target.

options.text: The midpoint residual is always exactly zero
options.why: Nonsquare roots need not have rational midpoints.
Monotonic square on the nonnegative domain gives the enclosure.

options.text: Every endpoint may be negative with no other checks
options.why: Monotonicity used here is specifically on the nonnegative domain.

items.explanation: The squared inequalities and nonnegative ordered endpoints support a root-location statement without a rounded sqrt oracle.
